data.one_liner: Allows users to pick a document and copies it to the app temporary directory.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to select single or multiple documents via native pickers on Android and iOS. Copied files are stored in the app's temporary directory. Includes support for filtering by file extensions, UTI types, and MIME types.
use_when: You need users to select documents from their device storage.
You want picked documents automatically copied to the app's temporary directory.
You need to restrict selectable files by extensions, MIME types, or UTI types.
avoid_when: You are building for platforms other than Android and iOS.
Your Android app requires a minSdkVersion lower than 19.
strengths: Supports picking single and multiple files.
Provides filters for extensions, MIME types, and UTI types.
Automatically copies selected files to the temporary directory.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms.

alternatives.name: file_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a more comprehensive file picking solution across multiple platforms with active maintenance.
